mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation (conversation_id, user_id, title, next_sequence_no, status, last_message_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{nextSequenceNo}, #{status}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{deletedAt})
